title: Favorite musicians and favorite trumpet players
summary: Punch names his favorites, including Buddy Petit and Johnny Dodds, and the trumpeter he heard on excursions as a kid.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Well, no. Okay. Now, listen, tell me who your favorite musicians were. Did Bill ever ask you that?

Lewis is my favorite. Yeah. Always was. And the boy that I admire a lot now is Dave, Buddy Petit. That's the fellow I really did admire last year. And come to Plan Epsom thing, well, I thought about Johnny Ducks. Always did. You know, got to tell the truth about it.
Well, when you were young, who was your favorite trumpet player when you were a kid?
Oh, you know, you mean while we were playing?
No, before you started playing, he didn't mean anything when you was a kid.
Yeah. I didn't know him that good, but I heard him on excursions after excursions.
Yeah. Them days. He's a little help. Well, I didn't know anybody. That's about the only one I heard, you know.
Oh, well, so you know anybody better start with, Buck. That's Bill's favorite, you know. And who did you like trombone?
